title: Closest Dessert Cost
summary: You must choose exactly one ice cream base and zero or more toppings, with no more than two of each topping.
statement: You must choose exactly one ice cream base and zero or more toppings, with no more than two of each topping. Given the cost of each base and each topping, along with a target cost, determine the cost of the dessert that is closest to the target. If there are multiple costs equally close to the target, return the lower one.
constraints: Choose exactly one base and zero, one, or two of each topping.
Minimize absolute difference from target; if two totals tie, return the smaller total.
hints: Each topping independently has multiplicity zero, one, or two.
Grow the set of attainable totals from all bases by adding one and two copies of each topping.
Choose the cost with key (absolute difference,cost).
The set expansion enumerates every legal combination exactly as a sequence of multiplicity choices, and the key enforces both optimization rules.

tests.explanation: Base seven plus topping three reaches target exactly.
The closest attainable total is seventeen, using base three and two each of toppings four and five.
